About

I'm a designer passionate about creating compelling visual identities, engaging graphics, and intuitive digital experiences. I combine visual creativity with user-centered thinking to create designs that communicate clearly and solve real problems.

I'm an emerging designer with UI/UX internship experience and an Electronics and Communication Engineering background, which shapes how systematically I plan an interface from user flow to final screen.
